events.label: Germany Bundeswehr personnel and service survey data July 2026

slots.name: troop total
slots.sentence: The Defense Ministry said the total of around 186,700 put the military inside its recruitment target window for this year with months to spare

slots.name: recruitment target total
slots.sentence: By the mid-2030s, Germany aims to recruit some 70,000 more full-time troops than it currently has on retainer, to reach a full-time force of around 260,000 plus around 200,000 reservists.

slots.name: historical high years
slots.sentence: It also said it was the highest total in 'around 13 years,' soon after the 2011 abolition of the country's former period of mandatory national service for many young men

slots.name: troop increase
slots.sentence: The total was an increase of roughly 3,700 troops, or around 2% of the total force, since the previous July

slots.name: recruitment applications
slots.sentence: Applications were also up 26% year-on-year, at 47,300 in total

slots.name: new hires
slots.sentence: New hires from those applications rose 12%, to 15,400

slots.name: career soldiers
slots.sentence: Roughly 61,500 are career soldiers on permanent contracts

slots.name: temporary contract troops
slots.sentence: The bulk of the full-time force, around 113,000 troops, are on long-term temporary contracts

slots.name: volunteer forces
slots.sentence: Short-term contract soldiers and volunteer forces' numbers also rose by about 6%, to around 12,100 in total

slots.name: deployed personnel
slots.sentence: Fewer than 1,000 of Germany's military personnel are currently on deployment

slots.name: men response rate
slots.sentence: Of around 194,000 men surveyed, 96% responded.

slots.name: women response rate
slots.sentence: But of 184,000 women and people of other genders questioned, only 4% voluntarily replied.

slots.name: interest rating
slots.sentence: The ministry said that if you excluded people who responded with a 0 when asked to rank their interest in joining the military from 0 to 10, then the average figure given was a 5.

slots.name: assessment participants
slots.sentence: It said the questionnaires had led to 2,630 people coming in for assessments, and 865 people signing up for active service, starting either this year or in 2027.

slots.name: active service signups
slots.sentence: "This proportional increase in staff is an 'add-on' — that is, a supplement to the extensive recruitment efforts that have contributed to the very encouraging number of applications and hires mentioned above," the Defense Ministry wrote.
